mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS over 3 months, or rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% for 3 months, or rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate a weakening housing market that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with both RSAFS and HOUST declining >0.5% in 1 month, or rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with RSAFS increasing for 6 months, or rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 5.0% and nonfarm payrolls decline exceeding 100,000 persons in one month indicate labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS decline > 100 in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS decline > 100 in 1 month, or rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In slow GDP growth regimes (annualized GDP growth < 1.5%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100 thousand units signals housing sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 growth < 1.5% annually and HOUST decline, or rank IC remains below 0.03.
